plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Role identity and phase protocol for the review role on contract v3 (directive facets, phase-1/phase-2 write scoping, resume-state hook). Methodology enforcement lives in the sibling review-traceability/review-severity/review-record-norm/review-proposal-completeness plugins.

plugins.name: review-traceability
plugins.description: Per-requirement conformance traceability (ISO 19011/IIA evidence-based, independent verdicts; spec_ref + evidence field enforcement, issues #30/#37/#38).

plugins.name: review-severity
plugins.description: Deterministic severity table-lookup enforcement (Chromium/Microsoft bug-bar shape); denies DREAD-style averaged scores.

plugins.name: review-record-norm
plugins.description: code_under_review: / closed_checks sha-matched evidence discipline for phase-2 review records.

plugins.name: review-proposal-completeness
plugins.description: freelunch-grade structural completeness bar for this role's own phase-1 proposals (Request/Constraints/sourced-adoption/adopt-vs-skip/How-this-will-be-judged).

plugins.name: review-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install bundle pulling in review, review-traceability, review-severity, review-record-norm, and review-proposal-completeness as dependencies. Contains no code of its own.
